Por Chon uses a daily 19:00 cutoff. For each completed cutoff window, if the highest H4 wick/high made before 19:00 exceeds the previous Por Chon high frame by more than 1,000 project points, that highest H4 high becomes the new Por Chon New-High/ATH frame; otherwise keep the prior frame. Post-19:00 movement rolls into the next cutoff window.

Core cutoff/high-selection/>1000 semantics are therefore first-party Por Chon teaching, while the YouTube Show transcript still carries ASR risk. Asia/Bangkok mapping is a project contextual interpretation, not a literal timezone quote.

claims.canonical_statement: Por Chon ATH is used as counter/reversal context after price has run substantially beyond its normal round; over-round context alone is not sufficient without reversal evidence.
In the evidenced Por Chon over-round reversal usage, price does not have to touch the ATH line before a valid reversal signal can be acted on.
Por Chon ATH reversal usage is not normally preferred during Sideway; this is a preference statement, not a proven universal prohibition.

In the supplied M5 PA Sell over-round example, the relative states to place SL below the ATH line; the ATH line is visibly above the reversal/entry area, so this relation is geometrically compatible with Sell. Exact buffer and universality remain unresolved.
